title: Reorder List
description:
You are given the head of a singly linked-list. The list can be represented as: 
 
```
L
0
 → L
1
 → … → L
n - 1
 → L
n
```

 Reorder the list to be on the following form: 
 
```
L
0
 → L
n
 → L
1
 → L
n - 1
 → L
2
 → L
n - 2
 → …
```

 You may not modify the values in the list's nodes. Only nodes themselves may be changed. 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/03/04/reorder1linked-list.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 head = [1,2,3,4]

Output:
 [1,4,2,3]
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/03/09/reorder2-linked-list.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 head = [1,2,3,4,5]

Output:
 [1,5,2,4,3]
```

 Constraints: 

 The number of nodes in the list is in the range [1, 5 * 10 4 ] . 
 
 1 <= Node.val <= 1000
